name: San Japan
blurb: The largest anime and gaming convention in South Texas, held on Labor Day Weekend at the Henry B. Gonzalez Convention Center in San Antonio.

editions.venue: Henry B. Gonzalez Convention Center & San Antonio Grand Hyatt
editions.evidence: Homepage: 'WELCOME TO SAN JAPAN 18 SEPTEMBER 3RD – SEPTEMBER 5TH, 2027 henry b. gonzalez convention center san antonio, texas' with a live countdown; body text: 'It occurs at the Henry B. Gonzalez Convention Center and the San Antonio Grand Hyatt within downtown San Antonio on Labor Day Weekend'.

notes: The /guests/ page's entire roster (44 named guests plus two VTuber-announcement galleries) sits under a heading that reads '2026 GUESTS WILL BE CONTINUALLY ANNOUNCED UP THROUGH THE MIDDLE OF AUGUST' and a repeated '2026 Guests' banner further down -- i.e. it is still the prior (already-completed) edition's lineup, not 2027's, so guests is 'none-yet'.
